channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Former SNP chief accused of embezzling almost £500,000 from party
item.description: New details have emerged of the charges against the ex-husband of Nicola Sturgeon.

item.title: German Chancellor warns rules-based world order no longer exists
item.description: The German Chancellor has warned that the rules-based world order no longer exists.

item.title: Exclusive: Former Prince Andrew tried to facilitate Epstein-Gaddafi meeting
item.description: The emails were included in the latest dump of Epstein files from the US Department of Justice, and have been uncovered for the first time by Channel 4 News.

item.title: How will the government appeal the Palestine Action ruling? Barrister explains
item.description: We spoke to the barrister Jonathan Hall KC, who is the Independent Reviewer of Terrorism Legislation and State Threats Legislation.

item.title: Trump revokes key climate ruling on greenhouse gases
item.description: He's called it a hoax and scam, but now President Trump has gone one step further in his war on the climate change consensus.

item.title: Farmers worry for crops with yet more rain in February
item.description: So far this year, the rain has been relentless across the UK, causing flooding, damage and disruption.

item.title: We speak to whistleblower whose complaints prompted investigation into Dame Antonia
item.description: We spoke to the woman whose allegations against Dame Antonia prompted the Foreign Office investigation.

item.title: Bullying complaints against Starmer’s likely new Cabinet Secretary were ‘buried’ – C4 News finds
item.description: Channel 4 News can reveal serious allegations that a Foreign Office investigation into the woman likely to become Keir Starmer's new Cabinet Secretary found "a case to answer" for disciplinary action that was "buried" by those at the top of the Civil Service in the Cabinet Office.

item.title: Courts tool shut down by government after data allegedly shared with AI company
item.description: It's been described as a "game changer" and an "indispensable tool" for journalists covering the UK's byzantine criminal court system.

item.title: Former Oxfam CEO takes legal action against charity over accusations of ‘racism and antisemitism’
item.description: The former Chief Executive of Oxfam in the UK is taking legal action against the charity, accusing it of racism, sexism and antisemitism.
